name: Andaz Prague
positioning: Andaz lifestyle hotel in the historic Sugar Palace in the heart of Prague's historical center, with rooms that draw on Prague's myths and legends
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable base in Prague's historical center
Guests drawn to heritage buildings and storytelling design
Families who want connecting rooms, and travelers with dogs

facts.text: Andaz Prague is a lifestyle hotel set in the historic Sugar Palace building.
The hotel sits in the heart of Prague's historical center.
Old Town Square is a short walk from the hotel.
Some king rooms have a private balcony overlooking St. Henry's churchyard.
Some suites overlook the Dancing Fountain, Haymarket or Jindrisska Tower.
The Junior Suite has art deco design influences.
The Wintergarden Equilibrium Suite includes a private gymnasium.
The Family Room has connecting king and twin bedrooms overlooking a quiet courtyard.
MEZ Bar serves cocktails inspired by Bohemian mythology.
The hotel hosts Le Petit Chef and Friends, an immersive 3D mapping dinner show.
The hotel is pet friendly and offers a VID (Very Important Dog) service.

highlights.text: Rooms carry design references to Prague legends, including Bruncvik's lion above the bedpost and Princess Libuse.
The Wintergarden Suites are built around a winter garden and have high ceilings.
The Presidential Suite has original moldings, high ceilings, a marble fireplace and a winter garden.
ZEM is an avant-garde Czech bistro whose menu blends Czech produce with occasional Japanese flavors, cooked over charcoal and steam.

considerations.text: Vaclav Havel Airport Prague is 7.5 miles from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing for the luxury boutique experience.
WhataHotel notes the modern design may not appeal to traditional luxury seekers.
